name: personal-work-memory-gauntlet-v1
provenance: Curated from recurring usage categories; not historical task outcomes. Rubrics score bounded answers, not whole-task success.

cases.question: Recall the accuracy workflow: when a UI score is wrong, which two layers must be checked?

sources.heading: Source and render accuracy
sources.body: Check provider source data and rendered UI before changing the score. Cosmetic patches alone cannot verify accuracy.

sources.heading: Meeting logistics
sources.body: Meetings use calendar invitations with an agenda and an owner.

cases.question: Recall the provider status policy. A provider timed out. What status should it have?

sources.heading: Partial provider unavailable
sources.body: A provider timeout is unavailable evidence. Do not turn missing evidence into a score of zero or an assessment failure.
